# Limited Dependent Variables

- So far `y` has been continuous. Lots of outcomes aren't continuous though:  
  - Binary  
  - Unordered Categorical  
  - Ordered Categorical  
  - Counts  
- OLS will still be able to run on all of these, so what does the $\hat{\beta}$ mean?  


## The Linear Probability Model
- $\beta_1$ is the change in the probability that y = 1 from a one-unit change in x.
  - this is percentage points, not percent
